offers.name: ASUS ROG Strix SCAR 18 (2026) Gaming Laptop (18" 4K 240Hz Display / Intel Core Ultra 9 290HX Plus / NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 / 64GB RAM / 4TB / Windows 11 Home / G835LXG-DS99-CA)

reviews.quote: Gaming Monster with 4K Mini-LED, RTX 5090, and 128 GB RAM.
A gigantic gaming laptop with a lot to like — but not nearly as inexpensive as this kind of machine comes.
A no-compromise flagship: monster RTX 5090 performance paired with a stunning 4K Mini-LED panel.

praises: Top-of-stack mobile gaming: RTX 5090 24GB at full SCAR wattage — no laptop game unplayable at native res with DLSS (inferred from 2025 SCAR 18 line pool, 4.57/5 n=355)
18" 4K 240Hz Mini-LED with 2,000+ dimming zones and 100% DCI-P3 — the best display ASUS has ever put in a laptop per SCAR-line reception
64GB DDR5-6400 + 4TB RAID 0 standard — no upgrade needed ever; both still user-serviceable
24GB VRAM makes it the serious local-AI/LLM laptop of the Windows gaming class (CUDA + VRAM headroom)
Full desktop I/O: Thunderbolt 4, HDMI 2.1, 2.5G ethernet — designed to dock permanently
complaints: $8,000-8,500 CAD — exceeds most desktop PCs with better raw performance
Heaviest tier of the line (~3.3 kg + 330W adapter); portability effectively zero
Native-4K AAA gaming still needs DLSS/frame-gen on max settings despite the 5090
5090 in even this big chassis is power-capped relative to desktop; marginal gain over the $4k 5080 tier for ~2x the price
Same line-level gripes carry over: Turbo fan noise, Armoury Crate bloat, plastic deck flex, ~4h battery

design_philosophy: The 2026 SCAR 18 G835LXG is the apex of ASUS's desktop-replacement philosophy: nothing held back — 24GB-VRAM RTX 5090 at full sustained power, the first 4K 240Hz Mini-LED Nebula panel on a gaming laptop, 64GB and 4TB RAID 0 out of the box. It exists for buyers who refuse to compromise on a single spec and accept weight, price, and battery as irrelevant. This DS99-CA top tier is the only 5090 SCAR sold at Canadian retail.
